typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsTradeCancelCorrectStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BRANCH as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		VDATE as string,
		REVDATE as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		CCY as string,
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		CORPTRAD as string,
		CORPPORT as string,
		IOPER as string,
		REVOPER as string,
		REVREASON as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		PAYAUTHDTE as timestamp,
		INPUTDATE as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PS as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		INTRATE as string,
		SPREAD_8 as decimal(18,8),
		CTRAMT as string,
		CMNE as string,
		CFN1 as string,
		CTRCCY as string,
		OPERNAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicPlusDBDLDT	source(output(
		BRANCH as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		CFN1 as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		VDATE as string,
		REVDATE as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		CCY as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		CTRCCY as string,
		CTRAMT as decimal(19,4),
		CCYRATE_8 as decimal(18,8),
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		CORPTRAD as string,
		CORPPORT as string,
		IOPER as string,
		REVOPER as string,
		REVREASON as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		PAYAUTHDTE as timestamp,
		INPUTDATE as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PS as string,
		INTRATE as string,
		OPERNAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicPlusDBFXDH	source(output(
		Dealno as string,
		REVDATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OpicPlusDBDLDT derive({Copy of INTRATE} = INTRATE,
		{Copy of REVDATE} = REVDATE,
		{Copy of SPREAD_8} = toString(SPREAD_8),
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = CTRAMT,
		{Copy of PS} = PS) ~> ConvertDatecolumnstostring0
OpicPlusDBFXDH derive({Copy of REVDATE} = REVDATE,
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = toString(CTRAMT),
		{Copy of INTRATE} = INTRATE,
		{Copy of PS} = PS,
		{Copy of CCYRATE_8} = toString(CCYRATE_8)) ~> ConvertDatecolumnstostring
ConvertDatecolumnstostring0 select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of REVDATE} = {Copy of REVDATE},
		{Copy of SPREAD_8} = {Copy of SPREAD_8},
		{Copy of INTRATE} = {Copy of INTRATE},
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = {Copy of CTRAMT},
		{Copy of PS} = {Copy of PS},
		SPREAD_8 = SPREAD_8,
		PS = PS,
		REVDATE = REVDATE,
		INTRATE = INTRATE,
		CTRAMT = CTRAMT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> ConvertDatecolumnstostring00
ConvertDatecolumnstostring select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of REVDATE} = {Copy of REVDATE},
		{Copy of CCYRATE_8} = {Copy of CCYRATE_8},
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = {Copy of CTRAMT},
		{Copy of PS} = {Copy of PS},
		{Copy of INTRATE} = {Copy of INTRATE},
		PS = PS,
		REVDATE = REVDATE,
		CCYRATE_8 = CCYRATE_8,
		INTRATE = INTRATE,
		CTRAMT = CTRAMT
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> ConvertDatecolumnstostring01
ConvertDatecolumnstostring00 derive(drv2_REVDATE = toTimestamp(toString(({Copy of REVDATE}), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')) ~> ConverttoDate0
ConvertDatecolumnstostring01 derive(drv2_REVDATE = toTimestamp(toString(({Copy of REVDATE}), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),
		CTRAMT = toString(CTRAMT),
		CCYRATE_8 = toDecimal(CCYRATE_8,18,8)) ~> ConverttoDate
ConverttoDate,ConverttoDate0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
UnionAll derive({Copy of OPERNAME} = OPERNAME,
		{Copy of CFN1} = CFN1,
		{Copy of CORPTRAD} = CORPTRAD,
		{Copy of IOPER} = IOPER,
		{Copy of CTRCCY} = CTRCCY,
		{Copy of BRANCH} = BRANCH,
		{Copy of DEALNO} = DEALNO,
		{Copy of CCYRATE_8} = toString(CCYRATE_8),
		{Copy of drv3_REVDATE} = toString(drv3_REVDATE),
		{Copy of PS} = PS,
		{Copy of CMNE} = CMNE,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of TRAD} = TRAD,
		{Copy of CCYAMT} = toString(CCYAMT),
		{Copy of CORPPORT} = CORPPORT,
		{Copy of REVTEXT} = REVTEXT,
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = CTRAMT,
		{Copy of INTRATE} = INTRATE,
		{Copy of PORT} = PORT,
		{Copy of INPUTDATE} = INPUTDATE,
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = DEALSRCE,
		{Copy of REVREASON} = REVREASON,
		{Copy of DEALDATE} = DEALDATE,
		{Copy of REVOPER} = REVOPER,
		{Copy of SEQ} = SEQ,
		{Copy of PRODUCT} = PRODUCT,
		{Copy of VDATE} = VDATE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of DEALNO} == LookupLKPTABLE@Dealno && {Copy of drv3_REVDATE} == LookupLKPTABLE@REVDATE,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of VDATE} = {Copy of VDATE},
		{Copy of TRAD} = {Copy of TRAD},
		{Copy of SEQ} = {Copy of SEQ},
		{Copy of REVTEXT} = {Copy of REVTEXT},
		{Copy of REVREASON} = {Copy of REVREASON},
		{Copy of REVOPER} = {Copy of REVOPER},
		{Copy of PS} = {Copy of PS},
		{Copy of PRODUCT} = {Copy of PRODUCT},
		{Copy of PORT} = {Copy of PORT},
		{Copy of OPERNAME} = {Copy of OPERNAME},
		{Copy of IOPER} = {Copy of IOPER},
		{Copy of INTRATE} = {Copy of INTRATE},
		{Copy of INPUTDATE} = {Copy of INPUTDATE},
		{Copy of drv3_REVDATE} = {Copy of drv3_REVDATE},
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = {Copy of DEALSRCE},
		{Copy of DEALNO} = {Copy of DEALNO},
		{Copy of DEALDATE} = {Copy of DEALDATE},
		{Copy of CTRCCY} = {Copy of CTRCCY},
		{Copy of CTRAMT} = {Copy of CTRAMT},
		{Copy of CORPTRAD} = {Copy of CORPTRAD},
		{Copy of CORPPORT} = {Copy of CORPPORT},
		{Copy of CMNE} = {Copy of CMNE},
		{Copy of CFN1} = {Copy of CFN1},
		{Copy of CCYRATE_8} = {Copy of CCYRATE_8},
		{Copy of CCYAMT} = {Copy of CCYAMT},
		{Copy of CCY} = {Copy of CCY},
		{Copy of BRANCH} = {Copy of BRANCH},
		CTRCCY = CTRCCY,
		PS = PS,
		INPUTDATE = INPUTDATE,
		TRAD = TRAD,
		REVREASON = REVREASON,
		OPERNAME = OPERNAME,
		DEALDATE = DEALDATE,
		REVOPER = REVOPER,
		REVTEXT = REVTEXT,
		PRODUCT = PRODUCT,
		CCYRATE_8 = CCYRATE_8,
		DEALNO = UnionAll@DEALNO,
		CFN1 = CFN1,
		drv3_REVDATE = drv3_REVDATE,
		CTRAMT = CTRAMT,
		CORPPORT = CORPPORT,
		VDATE = VDATE,
		BRANCH = BRANCH,
		CCYAMT = CCYAMT,
		PORT = PORT,
		INTRATE = INTRATE,
		DEALSRCE = DEALSRCE,
		CCY = CCY,
		CORPTRAD = CORPTRAD,
		SEQ = SEQ,
		IOPER = IOPER,
		CMNE = CMNE,
		PAYAUTHDTE = PAYAUTHDTE,
		drv2_REVDATE = drv2_REVDATE,
		{Copy of REVDATE} = {Copy of REVDATE},
		REVDATE = LookupLKPTABLE@REVDATE,
		Dealno = UnionAll@DEALNO
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		CTRCCY as string,
		PS as string,
		INPUTDATE as string,
		TRAD as string,
		REVREASON as string,
		OPERNAME as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		REVOPER as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCYRATE_8 as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		CFN1 as string,
		PAYAUTHDTE as string,
		CTRAMT as string,
		CORPPORT as string,
		VDATE as string,
		BRANCH as string,
		CCYAMT as string,
		PORT as string,
		REVDATE as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		intrate as string,
		CCY as string,
		CORPTRAD as string,
		SEQ as string,
		CMNE as string,
		IOPER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CTRCCY = {Copy of CTRCCY},
		PS = {Copy of PS},
		INPUTDATE = {Copy of INPUTDATE},
		TRAD = {Copy of TRAD},
		REVREASON = {Copy of REVREASON},
		OPERNAME = {Copy of OPERNAME},
		DEALDATE = {Copy of DEALDATE},
		REVOPER = {Copy of REVOPER},
		REVTEXT = {Copy of REVTEXT},
		PRODUCT = {Copy of PRODUCT},
		CCYRATE_8,
		DEALNO = {Copy of DEALNO},
		CFN1 = {Copy of CFN1},
		PAYAUTHDTE,
		CTRAMT = {Copy of CTRAMT},
		CORPPORT = {Copy of CORPPORT},
		VDATE = {Copy of VDATE},
		BRANCH = {Copy of BRANCH},
		CCYAMT = CTRAMT,
		PORT = {Copy of PORT},
		REVDATE = drv3_REVDATE,
		DEALSRCE = {Copy of DEALSRCE},
		intrate = {Copy of INTRATE},
		CCY = {Copy of CCY},
		CORPTRAD = {Copy of CORPTRAD},
		SEQ = {Copy of SEQ},
		CMNE = {Copy of CMNE},
		IOPER = {Copy of IOPER}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsTradeCancelCorrectStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsTradeCancelCorrectStaging
